subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition, if any, should Skill Workshop support for quarantined proposals?
rationale: Quarantine is a safety state, and changing it from terminal to recoverable affects scanner semantics, audit expectations, and public CLI/Gateway/UI behavior; automation should not choose that policy alone.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and explicit audit metadata.

options.title: Unify with restore semantics
options.body: Wait for the rejected-restore direction to settle, then extend the same public restore or reopen model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one lifecycle verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Leave quarantined proposals immutable safety holds and document recreate-as-new as the supported recovery if maintainers want strict containment.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and explicit audit metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history on adjacent Skill Workshop lifecycle, UI, and approval surfaces likely to shape the product/security decision.
